svg.desc: Report discovery and review · retrospective workflow specification. Full retrospective wireframe process with 8 editable screen frames, flow, annotations, and acceptance criteria.
svg.text: Report discovery and review · retrospective workflow specification
RETROSPECTIVE PRODUCT DESIGN PROCESS · STRUCTURE → TASK FLOW → STATES → HANDOFF
Each frame shows one meaningful customer state. Arrows and labels describe transitions between frames.

g.text: Choose a region and report year
